OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages

## Summary

I implemented the optional owner `email` field per the spec: when present it must be a syntactically valid address, and it's stored and returned lower-cased; when present but invalid, the request is rejected with 400.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema (`type: string`, `format: email`, `maxLength: 255`), not in `required`. Because the generator runs with `performBeanValidation`, this produces an `@Email` constraint on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`, so a malformed address is rejected with 400 via the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` advice.

2. **`Owner.java`** (entity) — Added the `email` column with getter/setter (and to `toString`). MapStruct maps it automatically between `Owner` and the DTOs.

3. **DB schema** — Added the `email` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`). The test profile uses `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema change is required for persistence.

4. **`hsqldb/data.sql`** — The seed inserts used positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)`, which broke on the new column ("row column count mismatch"). Switched them to explicit column lists. (h2/postgres already used explicit lists; mysql has no owner seed rows.)

5. **`OwnerRestControllerV1`** — Added `normalizeEmail(...)`: an absent/blank email is left unset; a present value is validated against a syntactic regex and lower-cased, throwing `InvalidEmailException` otherwise. Wired into both `addOwner` (create) and `updateOwner`, mirroring the existing telephone-normalization pattern.

6. **`InvalidEmailException`** + **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — New exception and handler returning 400 with `errors: ["email"]`, mirroring `InvalidTelephoneException`.

The three new acceptance tests (`coreLowercasesEmail`, `errorRejectsInvalidEmail`, `functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail`) all pass.
